scope: historical successful fixture run: NPC task acceptance, equipment fixture, one natural enemy kill and isolated programmatic save/load
limitations: Fixture loads city and combat stages and repositions the player; it grants level 30 and a level-27 sword.
Enemy AI, HP and damage remain enabled and unmodified, but this is not representative chapter difficulty.
Only one of twenty objective enemies was defeated; quest completion and reward claim are not covered.
Save and load were invoked programmatically, not through the system-menu UI.
A separate level-10 iron-sword run ended in player death with the objective still at 20; equipment and tactics were fixture-limited, so no balance conclusion is implied.
Mouse events are simulated. This passing run used zero direct event fallbacks; prior intermittent synthetic input failures remain recorded.
A later repeat with the level-30 fixture ended in player death before the objective kill; results are not repeatable evidence of balance or a completed journey.
Recorded source hashes refer to the successful run before the subsequent cleanup change.
